title: Tranquility
author: Linda Leslie
problems: Row 4 "pass through to an ocean wave - robins by left in the center, neighbors by right on the sides" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 7 "form an ocean wave & balance - robins by left hands and neighbors by right hands" can't start from where the dancers are: The robins cannot join left hands facing the way they do.
Row 9 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's partner is outside the group.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
